title: Naturality of the normalized integral tensor associator on derived morphisms
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $W$ on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the derived-complete constructible category and the completed tensor of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison], together with the normalized integral associator of [def-pod-integral-tensor-constraints]. In the derived-complete constructible integral category, with the prescribed completed tensor $T$ and normalized integral associator $\alpha^{\mathrm{int}}$, every triple of morphisms $f:A\to A'$, $g:B\to B'$, $h:C\to C'$ satisfies
$$T(T(f,g),h);\alpha^{\mathrm{int}}_{A',B',C'}=\alpha^{\mathrm{int}}_{A,B,C};T(f,T(g,h)).$$
